label: TP
reason: User-controlled input from HTTP header flows through URL decoding into a cryptographic operation, then gets converted to HTML via encodeForHTML() and concatenated directly into the HTTP response writer without proper escaping. The substring trimming does not affect the XSS risk as it operates on the decoded string which still contains malicious payloads.

evidence.note: User input read from HTTP header and URL decoded
Encoded input concatenated directly to response without HTML escaping
